The later alligator app is a helper app to let the user figure out a certain time given current time, and the change. THe user can pick a starting time and then add 0 or more intervals, such as "10 weeks" that then get added to the starting time. The user can also pick a time to go back, such as "35 minutes ago" There should be an option for hours, minutes, days, months, etc. The result should be output toward the bottom of the screen, and it should automatically update as intervals are added. When setting the start time, it should default to whatever the current system time is, but the user can change the year, month, day, hour, or minutes.
